s: Who was the founder of the Asaf Jahi Dynasty in the Deccan?
x:
The Asaf Jahi Dynasty was founded by Mir Qamar-ud-din Khan, popularly known as Nizam-ul-Mulk Asaf Jah I, in 1724 CE. Initially appointed as the Mughal Governor of the Deccan by Emperor Farrukhsiyar, he defeated Mubariz Khan in the Battle of Shakar Kheda (1724) and established an independent state with Hyderabad as its centre. The Asaf Jahi rulers governed Hyderabad until 1948, when Hyderabad State was integrated into the Indian Union after Operation Polo. Hence, the correct answer is Option (2).
